prompt: A soft, intimate 35mm photograph shot from slightly above, looking down at a beautiful young East Asian woman in her early 20s sitting on the edge of a white bed. She leans forward slightly, one hand resting on the mattress behind her for support, and looks up at the camera with large, wide dark brown eyes and soft, slightly parted lips — an innocent, vulnerable expression, as if gazing up at someone she trusts. Cheeks flushed a gentle pink. She has very long, dark brown hair with soft bangs across her forehead, the lengths flowing down over her shoulders and cascading to her waist, the ends catching warm amber light. She wears a simple black satin slip dress with thin spaghetti straps, the fabric opaque and smooth with a subtle sheen, a straight neckline sitting across her collarbone, the slip falling to mid-thigh. The satin drapes softly over her curves — the weight of the fabric following the shape of her full bust and skimming inward at her narrow waist before pooling loosely at her lap. Over the slip, an oversized white men's dress shirt worn completely open and unbuttoned, slipping off her right shoulder, the long sleeves loosely covering her arms. The crisp white cotton against the dark satin creates a clean contrast that frames her silhouette. The background is bright, clean, and overexposed — soft white light flooding in from behind, creating a high-key ethereal glow that halos around her hair and the white shirt. Tight framing from her hips to above her head. 85mm lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, everything beyond her dissolving into pure white light. Warm, delicate, tender editorial boudoir aesthetic.
